20105.d: The Pirates' Cove is a small island located in the Lunar Sea north of the Fremennik Province.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Pirates' Cove can be accessed only by boat. Players may reach the island either by the 'Travel-Pirates' Cove' option on Lokar Searunner in Rellekka or by the 'Travel' option on Captain Bentley on Lunar Isle, provided they have reached a certain point in Lunar Diplomacy. There is no fee either way.

There are no teleportation methods through which a player can immediately reach the island; however, players may reach the Lady Zays port of call on Lunar Isle more quickly by using the Lunar Isle lodestone or the Moonclan Teleport found in the lunar spells, which is a reward for the Lunar Diplomacy quest. Players can also access Rellekka more quickly through a variety of means, including the enchanted lyre or House Teleport spell (provided their player-owned house is in Rellekka).

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Pirates' Cove'

20106.d: The Pirates' Hideout is a building located in deep level 54-55 Wilderness.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
While there is no direct teleport to the Pirates' Hideout, there are a couple of relatively safe routes to take as the area is not often travelled by player killers.
• Using Slayer cape or Master slayer cape the player can teleport to Mandrith who is directly east of the Pirate's hideout.
• Using Wilderness sword 4 player can teleport directly to the Wilderness Agility Course and then can travel east to the hideout. 
• Using the Edgeville-Wilderness lever or the Ardougne-Wilderness lever to teleport to the Deserted Keep east of the Mage Arena. After cutting the spider web blocking the top of the exit from Deserted Keep, run west past the Mage Arena until you reach the hideout. In the past this was a popular player killing location so many players would run south of the Mage Arena and swing back north to the hideout which took longer. However, these days the route is fairly safe.
• Players who have completed Desert Treasure may use the Ghorrock Teleport to the Ice Plateau and run north through the gate and then east past the Wilderness Agility Course and then north to reach the hideout. Beware that this route will drop you directly into an area with aggressive Greater Demon Berserkers, and the route will take you past aggressive Wyverns and Glacors.

gt.heading: Getting to Elena
gt.text:
• Go north to the large building you first arrived at, in the town square.
• Talk to the Clerk on the floor 1, and tell him it's urgent. [Chat: 2 Who is through that door? › 1 This is urgent though!]
• Climb the stairs and enter the eastmost room.
• Talk to Bravek. [Chat: 1 This is really important though! › 3 Do you know what's in the cure?]
• Add the chocolate dust to the bucket of milk and then add snape grass to make a hangover cure.
• Talk to Bravek and give him the cure. [Chat: 3 They won't listen to me!]. He will give you a warrant to enter.
• Go back and enter the house with the black Xs.
• Search the barrel on the western side of the building's floor 1 to obtain a small key.
• Go down the stairs, open the gate and talk to Elena.

20152.d: Plague's End is a quest that features the Dark Lord, King Lathas, the Iorwerth Clan, and the west Ardougne plague.

gt.heading: Entering Prifddinas
gt.text:
After defeating the Dark Lord, exit the Grand Library and speak to Arianwyn, who will offer to teleport you to the entrance of the city. 

When you enter Prifddinas for the first time after crossing the guards at the entrance, the elven clan leaders will be waiting for you, lining the path to the gates of the city. Lord Amlodd, Lady Hefin, Lady Ithell, and Lady Trahaearn will stand on one side; Lord Crwys, Iesten Edern, and Lady Meilyr will stand on the other. As you pass them, each will say something kind to you, which could be any of the following: 
• May Seren guide you.
• Peace be with you.
• Prifddinas is growing!
• Rejoice!
• See you in the city.
• Thank you for everything!
• We are as one.
• We are home!
• Welcome, friend of the elves.
• Welcome, human!
You can optionally talk to any of them directly. Lord Amlodd, Lord Crwys, Lady Hefin, Iestin Edern, and Lady Ithell thank you for all that you have done for the elves and sing your praises; Lady Meilyr invites you to explore Prifddinas to your heart's content; and Lady Trahaearn advises you to "hurry along" so that you won't miss the growing of the Tower of Voices.

At the front gates, the last elven clan leader, Arianwyn, will be waiting for you. He will greet you warmly as a friend, and tell you that you have come at the right time to watch the fruits of your labour. At that point, a cutscene will unfold, which shows Prifddinas growing. The elves who were frozen in time when the city was reverted into a seed form spring to life everywhere around the city. The Tower of Voices rises, and you grab a peek of different parts of the city.

At the end of the cutscene, you may finally walk into the city gates. Arianwyn will stand at the gate until you walk inside, and then teleport away to his usual location in the Cadarn district of the city. Prifddinas music tracks will unlock, and the city is now yours to explore.
